description: Defines the ProxyClientSocket class, a base class for stream sockets tunneled through an HTTP proxy, including methods for handling proxy authentication and tunnel requests.

classes.name: ProxyClientSocket
classes.description: A base class for stream sockets tunneled through a proxy, providing methods for proxy authentication and connection management.

methods.name: GetConnectResponseInfo
methods.description: Returns the HttpResponseInfo from the response to the CONNECT request.

methods.name: GetAuthController
methods.description: Returns the HttpAuthController used for proxy authorization.

methods.name: RestartWithAuth
methods.description: Restarts the connection process with authentication credentials if an auth challenge was received.

methods.name: SetStreamPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the underlying stream (for SPDY and QUIC).
